title: Mongongo Liboso ya Mopɛpɛ makasi
intro: Moto moko na esobe atɛlɛmaki mpo na kobenga ekólo moko ya nguya azonga na solo. Bato yango bayebanaki mpo na bandako na bango ya kitoko mpe makasi na bango oyo ekokani na mosusu te. Nzokande lolendo na bango ekangaki bango miso, mpe baboyaki koyoka. Nsukansuka, etumbu moko ya mpasi ekwelaki bango, mpe etikalaki kaka mwa etuluku moke ya bandimi.
clues: Natindamaki epai ya bato moko ya nguya oyo bazalaki kofanda na bisika ya polele mpe bayebanaki mpo na nguya na bango.
Bato na ngai bayaki nsima ya ekólo mosusu monene oyo ebebisamaki.
Bazalaki na bandako kitoko mpe batongaki bandako milai.
Nabengaki bango mpo na kosambela Nzambe Moko, kasi baboyaki kotika bikeko na bango.
Etumbu moko ya mobulu ezwaki bango, kobikisa kaka baoyo bandimaki elongo na ngai.
Nazali moto oyo atindami epai ya bato moko ya nguya oyo bayebani na nkombo Aad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
